lines.text: My name is Lyra. I explore space. I visit places, make maps, and write down the things I find along the way.
I've found plenty of strange things. But one of them changed my plans.
It was a small object with a huge antenna, traveling far from any planet.
It came from a place called Earth. And it carried a message from a civilization I knew nothing about.
After that, I wanted to find out who had sent it so far away.
